alt_text: A gold frequency ring glows around the NDCH arch-and-Y emblem on black stone veined with gold, under the title MASTER MY FOCUS, NDCH FREQ 002. The picture pushes in slowly and the gold breathes brighter while one line repeats: I master my focus and actions.

location.name: Shaolin Temple
location.why: Bodhidharma is said to have sat facing a cave wall above the temple for nine years. Zen's whole idea of single-pointed attention starts on that mountain.

FREQ 002 | MASTER MY FOCUS

One thing at a time, all the way through.

Most days don't need more effort, they need fewer things competing for it. FREQ is a short NDCH series of affirmations set to sound: one sentence, repeated until it lands. This one runs over a 14.5 Hz binaural beat, so it's best with headphones.

#NDCH #Leadership #Productivity
